instruction: Use pass grep to find entries containing a string
Use pass to copy only the username field
output: pass show Website/example.com | head -n 1 | tr -d '\n' | xclip -selection clipboard

instruction: Use pass otp to generate a TOTP code
Use pass otp append to an entry
Use pass to show password from a specific key
Use pass to insert a password forcefully
Use gopass to show JSON formatted output
Use gopass to create a new mount
Use gopass to audit weak passwords
Use gopass to initialize with a YubiKey
Use gopass binary to validate a store
Use gopass to create an alias
Use op item create for a password item with URLs
Use op item create for a secure note
output: op item create --category secure_note --title 'Bank Info' --vault Private --notes 'Account number: 12345'

instruction: Use op item create for an API credential
output: op item create --category api_credential --title 'AWS Key' --vault Private --username AKIAXXXXX --password 'secret-key'

instruction: Use op item get to show specific fields only
output: op item get 'My Database' --fields username,password --format json

instruction: Use op item edit to change vault
Use op vault create
Use op user confirm for provisioning
Use op user edit to change name
Use op group create
Use op group edit
Use op group delete
Use keepassxc-cli show with attributes
output: keepassxc-cli show /tmp/test.kdbx -a Title -a UserName -a Password example.com
